resources.string:
Win the bout by landing more clean punches than your rival, or by knocking them down.

Each player has four pads on their side. JAB is quick and light. HOOK is slow and heavy: a yellow ! over the boxer warns that it is coming. Hold BLOCK to keep your guard up (it stops most of a jab and half of a hook). Tap DODGE just as a hook is about to land and it misses, leaving your rival open to a counter.

A jab cancels a punch that is still winding up. Every punch and dodge costs stamina, and a tired boxer cannot punch and hits softly, so do not just mash the pads.

Knocked down? Tap fast to get up before the count reaches ten. Three knockdowns in a round end the bout.

Turn-based assist, in the setup, removes the clock: you take turns choosing a punch and then a defence. It is also the best way to play with a screen reader.
